lead_raw_text:
The structure of SrNdBr₃ crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Imma (No. 38), with a unit cell containing 20 atoms (Sr₄Nd₄Br₁₂) distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Nd and Sr centers each coordinated by eight Br neighbors in a body-centered-cubic-like local arrangement, while Br environments involve two, three, or four neighbors of mixed Nd/Sr identity. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between 8-vertex Br polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing between Nd and Sr polyhedra; the periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 20 sites.
